messages:
anya: Heads-up — sketch for console: let users save a single 'View' that pins both route + model filters together so telemetry and quota previews line up.
mike: nice. quick q — what's the default scope for a saved View? org / team / route / personal?
sofia: my vote: default to route-scoped when created from a route page, otherwise personal. sharing option should be explicit.
kevin: must show token-burn and quota impact previews in the modal. product asked for cost + SLO signals.
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/482 (api + console changes)
mike: API proposal (very rough):
```
POST /api/views
{
  "name": "Payments: gpt4x probe",
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "route_abc",
  "model_filter": ["gpt4x", "opt-6b-quant"],
  "sampling_policy": "follow-route",
  "pin_aliases": ["latest-gpt4x"]
}
```
sofia: important: `sampling_policy` is needed. otherwise saved views will show inconsistent telemetry if sampling rates change.
anya: UX idea — show a small badge: "sampling: 10% (route default)" and a warning toast when the current route sampling differs from the view's sticky sampling.
kevin: rollout suggestion: backend stores sampling + API version with view. Canary to 10% orgs, telemetry gating enabled. We'll need an SRE runbook for cost preview jobs.
mike: one more: model lists can be huge. allow pinning model aliases (human-friendly) instead of raw model ids so renames don't break saved views.
sofia: permission edgecases: only route owners can set a route-default View. Others can save copies or request promote.
anya: I'll draft the spec for API + console mocks and include error cases (model alias missing, sampling mismatch, scope auth). tagging @design for mocks :wave:
kevin: thanks — ping me when draft is in docs, i'll reserve infra quota for the canary tests. :thumbsup:
